mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a cool 54 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under clear skies and a Waning Gibbous moon. Also, keep an eye out for the ISS at 5:05 AM, which will be visible as it travels from the area near Verona High School toward Madison.

In city news, the City of Verona continues its long-term engineering contract with AECOM for council support. Additionally, WisDOT is inviting the public to weigh in on the US 18/151 Corridor Study with meetings in Mount Horeb on November 18 and a virtual session on November 19.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today you can enjoy Live Music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at The Bogey Factory, or Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the fun continues with Main Street Trick or Treat, ART House 360, and Hop Haus Trivia.
Looking at the latest police report, on October 25, officers responded to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I offence.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM so make sure to plan your visit.
